notes: The ASV reorders the two similes; the units are matched to the Hebrew morphemes rather than to English order (rule 25).
The article assimilated into כָּ takes the written *the* of *as the wind*, while no article stands in כְעָב and the ASV writes *a cloud* (rules 12 and 15).
Both marginal alternatives (*Thou chasest*, *my nobility*) were read and set aside (rule 38).
